build_video_dataset_factory: build a subclass of BaseVideoDatasetFactory to create a custom video dataset from TFRecord shards
configure_dataset_factory: configure the BaseVideoDatasetFactory by calling configure with frame height, width, and frame count arguments
tune_dataset_performance: tune the dataset factory performance by adjusting shuffle buffer, parser threads, and prefetch buffer size
make_dataset_from_factory: make a tf.data.Dataset from a configured factory with specified batch size, shuffle, and epoch settings
add_custom_preprocess_fn: add a custom preprocessing function to the factory preprocessor builder before calling make_dataset
